name: DELTARUNE: Party (alpha test)
author: BBEE modding project
description: Kris from DELTARUNE as a playable character (ActorId 200801): the sword string, the air spin, dash, the party command (hold Skill: Susie's Rude Buster or Ralsei's Fireshock on the enemy you pick; Susie and Ralsei follow Kris) and the Summon Tactic. This alpha test package includes the DELTARUNE sprites, sounds and font it uses; they belong to DELTARUNE's owners. Needs bbee-sdk 0.3.3 or later. Unofficial.

enu.ActorSkillDesc_200801: Hold to slow time and pick an enemy, then let go: Susie throws Rude Buster at it, or Ralsei casts Fireshock (Dash swaps who acts). Each recharges for 1 second.
enu.TriggerDesc_208961: Once per room, when HP falls to 30% or less, restores HP and Susie and Ralsei are ready at once.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130802: A spinning slash that keeps your momentum. Can be used once while airborne.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130804: Hold to slow time and choose an enemy, then let go: Susie throws Rude Buster at it. A quick press fires at the nearest enemy.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130805: Ralsei casts Fireshock: it bursts on the chosen enemy and everything around it. While aiming, press <action=Dash> to swap between Susie and Ralsei.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130806: Susie and Ralsei follow Kris and act on command. Each recharges for 3 seconds after acting.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130807: Kris slashes twice. The two slashes cross in a large X that stays for a moment, damaging every enemy it touches.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130808: Jump. Has access to double jump in initial state.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130809: Dash forward. Enters a dodge state during the action.
enu.ActorActionDesc_130810: Keep <action=Dash> held after a dash to run at full speed with Susie and Ralsei.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120801: Deals more damage in a larger range.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120802: Every swing of the combo and the Spin Slash throw a crescent of energy that flies forward and cuts through enemies.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120803: Keep pressing <action=Attack> after the third swing to continue the combo. Each loop is faster.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120804: The third swing launches enemies and breaks Super Armor.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120806: Deals damage more times in a larger range.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120807: Hitting an enemy bounces you upward and resets the usage limit.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120808: Dives in a spin and lands with a shockwave.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120809: The bolt is larger and deals more damage.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120810: Chains to 2 more enemies after it hits.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120812: Knocks enemies away. Bosses are pushed back.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120813: Press <action=Skill> just as the bolt hits to add a shockwave.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120814: Rude Buster becomes Red Buster: it pierces enemies and chases the next one. It explodes on its third enemy, or when it hits a wall.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120816: The burst is larger and deals more damage.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120818: The burst chains to up to 3 more enemies and sets them on fire. Leaves burning ground, and burning enemies spread the fire to others nearby.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120819: A second burst erupts under every enemy hit.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120821: Rude Buster detonates burning enemies, damaging everything around them.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120822: When Susie and Ralsei are both ready, a command sends them both.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120823: Slash hits shorten Susie's and Ralsei's recharge.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120824: After Ralsei acts, restores 4% of max HP. This can happen once every 8 seconds.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120825: Keep <action=Attack> held after the first swing to charge, then let go at full charge. The X deals damage 4 times a second for 2 seconds. Can be used once every 5 seconds.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120826: You can jump thrice: When you get knocked away, you can press <action=Jump> to recover your stance. Recover to controllable state and become invincible for 1 second.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120827: While airborne, you can <color=#3AFDFFFF>Jump</color> and <color=#3AFDFFFF>Dash</color> to reset the attack limit for your <color=#3AFDFFFF>Universal Airborne Attacks</color>.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120829: Keep running at full speed with Susie and Ralsei. Nothing can hurt you while it lasts. You can jump, enemies in the way are knocked back and damaged, and projectiles in the way are destroyed.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120830: Runs faster and longer, hits harder, and crashing into a wall or a boss releases a shockwave.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120831: <color=#3AFDFFFF>Party of Three</color>: Deals 20% more damage while Susie and Ralsei are both ready.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120832: <color=#3AFDFFFF>Marked</color>: Enemies hit by a command take 20% more damage for 5 seconds.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120833: Press <action=Summon> to switch Auto on or off; the party strikes a pose, and the switch needs 2 seconds before it works again. On Auto, Susie and Ralsei pick enemies and attack on their own, each every 4 seconds, and their attacks deal 40% less damage.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120834: On Auto, Susie and Ralsei act every 3.5 seconds instead of every 4.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120835: On Auto, Susie and Ralsei act every 3 seconds, as fast as when you command them.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120836: <color=#3AFDFFFF>Graze</color>: Perfect dodges build 10 Tension instead of 5.
enu.ActorActionDesc_120899: Attacks and Skill damage increased by 20%
enu.ActorActionDesc_140801: The chain goes on to every enemy on screen, up to 8 hops.
enu.ActorActionDesc_140802: The chain carries fire to each enemy it reaches.
enu.ActorActionDesc_140806: The dash cuts in a wider range.
enu.ActorActionDesc_140807: Enemies knocked aside shorten the recharge.
enu.ActorActionDesc_140808: The dive bounces back up from the first enemy it hits.
enu.ActorActionDesc_140810: Every enemy the chain reaches is Marked.
enu.ActorActionDesc_140811: Bouncing off an enemy also restores a jump.

fac.ActorSkillDesc_200801: Hold to slow time and pick an enemy, then let go: Susie throws Rude Buster at it, or Ralsei casts Fireshock (Dash swaps who acts). Each recharges for 1 second.

fac.ActorActionDesc_130802: A spinning slash that keeps your momentum. Can be used once while airborne.

rus.ActorActionDesc_120813: Press <action=Skill> just as the bolt hits to add a shockwave.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120814: Rude Buster becomes Red Buster: it pierces enemies and chases the next one. It explodes on its third enemy, or when it hits a wall.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120816: The burst is larger and deals more damage.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120818: The burst chains to up to 3 more enemies and sets them on fire. Leaves burning ground, and burning enemies spread the fire to others nearby.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120819: A second burst erupts under every enemy hit.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120821: Rude Buster detonates burning enemies, damaging everything around them.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120822: When Susie and Ralsei are both ready, a command sends them both.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120823: Slash hits shorten Susie's and Ralsei's recharge.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120824: After Ralsei acts, restores 4% of max HP. This can happen once every 8 seconds.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120825: Keep <action=Attack> held after the first swing to charge, then let go at full charge. The X deals damage 4 times a second for 2 seconds. Can be used once every 5 seconds.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120826: Ты можешь совершить три прыжка. Когда тебя сбивают с ног, ты можешь нажать <action=Jump>, чтобы вернуться в стойку: восстанови контроль и получи неуязвимость на 1 секунду.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120827: В воздухе ты можешь совершить <color=#3AFDFFFF>прыжок</color> и <color=#3AFDFFFF>рывок</color>, чтобы обнулить лимит атак для твоих <color=#3AFDFFFF>Универсальных атак в воздухе</color>.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120829: Keep running at full speed with Susie and Ralsei. Nothing can hurt you while it lasts. You can jump, enemies in the way are knocked back and damaged, and projectiles in the way are destroyed.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120830: Runs faster and longer, hits harder, and crashing into a wall or a boss releases a shockwave.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120831: <color=#3AFDFFFF>Party of Three</color>: Deals 20% more damage while Susie and Ralsei are both ready.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120832: <color=#3AFDFFFF>Marked</color>: Enemies hit by a command take 20% more damage for 5 seconds.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120833: Press <action=Summon> to switch Auto on or off; the party strikes a pose, and the switch needs 2 seconds before it works again. On Auto, Susie and Ralsei pick enemies and attack on their own, each every 4 seconds, and their attacks deal 40% less damage.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120834: On Auto, Susie and Ralsei act every 3.5 seconds instead of every 4.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120835: On Auto, Susie and Ralsei act every 3 seconds, as fast as when you command them.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120836: <color=#3AFDFFFF>Graze</color>: Perfect dodges build 10 Tension instead of 5.
rus.ActorActionDesc_120899: Сила атаки и урон от навыков увеличены на 20%
rus.ActorActionDesc_140801: The chain goes on to every enemy on screen, up to 8 hops.
rus.ActorActionDesc_140802: The chain carries fire to each enemy it reaches.
rus.ActorActionDesc_140806: The dash cuts in a wider range.
rus.ActorActionDesc_140807: Enemies knocked aside shorten the recharge.
rus.ActorActionDesc_140808: The dive bounces back up from the first enemy it hits.
rus.ActorActionDesc_140810: Every enemy the chain reaches is Marked.
rus.ActorActionDesc_140811: Bouncing off an enemy also restores a jump.
